convert_detr_checkpoint: convert a DETR checkpoint from Facebook to a HuggingFace PyTorch model with optional hub upload
get_detr_config: get a DETR configuration object from a model name string with resnet backbone and label mappings
create_rename_keys: create a list of state dict key rename mappings between original DETR and HuggingFace DETR structures
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated query key value projection matrices into separate projection layers for encoder and decoder
test_conversion: test the converted DETR model against the original checkpoint outputs on a sample image
